thread:
Priya Sharma: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. leadership wants clean, specific target windows for three things: API runtime/observability, Console guided onboarding, and Optimize cost-presets. can owners + hard blockers + target dates be listed so comms can show concrete windows (marked as targets)?

Ben Ortiz: short answer: yes, but we must label them as "target windows" with dependency notes. i can hold publishing until we see canary traffic start for API.

Marco Valdez: proposing targets (scope notes included):
- API runtime v2 (streaming + observability hooks): canary 2024-05-21 -> GA 2024-05-31. scope: streaming stability, token-level traces, and SDK retries.
- Console guided onboarding + org templates: flags on 2024-06-09 -> beta 2024-06-16 -> GA 2024-06-30. scope: per-org templates, admin toggle, first-time UX flows.
- Optimize cost-presets (suggestions + unit-cost analyzer): internal alpha 2024-07-07 -> limited pilot 2024-07-14. scope: suggestion engine + cost dashboard; no billing automation in alpha.

Alice Chen: Console owner confirmed: Alice Chen. action: will post a feature-flag checklist and admin UI screenshot by 2024-05-02. need product review sign-off before beta.

Sofia Rivas: Optimize owner confirmed: Sofia Rivas. note: we need 3 pilot customers and an acceptance metric (suggestion acceptance rate > 20%) before expanding.

Dana Liu: SRE gating: SLO definitions + canary traffic profiles must be finalized by 2024-05-04. if not met, push API canary. also need acceptable error burst thresholds. Marco, please co-own SLO doc.

Evan Park: platform ask: owners, expected qps, and per-region replica counts by 2024-04-29 so we can reserve staging capacity. i'll post a reservation template in #eng-platform.

Marco Valdez: i'll draft the compatibility tests and SLO starter doc and tag Dana by 2024-04-28. will also prepare the SDK retry test plan.

Ben Ortiz: comms plan: i'll prepare webinar slide text with the three targets and clear qualifiers ("dependent on infra & SLO gating"). will not publish until either API canary starts or flags are on for Console beta.

Priya Sharma: can we capture explicit owners list here?
- API runtime: Marco Valdez
- Console onboarding: Alice Chen
- Optimize presets: Sofia Rivas
- Infra/SLOs: Dana Liu + Evan Park
- Comms: Ben Ortiz

Marco Valdez: confirmed. also flagging a blocker: quant infra calibration work must finish to enable Optimize recommendations; research estimate: 2 weeks after we freeze model snapshot.

release-bot: release note: staging cluster reservation queued for API canary 2024-05-01 03:30 UTC :rocket:

Priya Sharma: perfect. please drop any hard date conflicts or blockers in this thread by EOD so i can finalize the webinar slide and send to leadership.
